about: The two wording items #550 held for layout (batch 13, the remainder of the job). Gate 148's block O is run alone (CT_G148_ONLY=o, about 40 seconds a try) and every TC-R224o line is graded at his phone 375x761 and at 320x568: Home's Discover caption reads 'Openings, tactics, endgames' where those words fit on its one line and 'Openings & endgames' where they do not, whole both times, at no cost in height; it follows the width when the window changes and is still right back on Home after a puzzle; the phone puzzle row's Show button is named 'Show move' and its words are whole. NOT COVERED, said rather than implied: everything #550 built for this job (the developer tools hidden from players, the legal drafts, the setup errors, TXT-21 to TXT-40: gate 148's other blocks, TC-R224a to n, which this pair does not run); no width between 320 and 375 is a situation (360 measures 156px of slot, so it reads the short caption); the fit is measured in the gate browser's font, and his phone's own font is narrower or wider than it by an amount no gate here can read; the visible word on the puzzle row stays 'Show' (his call).

situations.name: se 320x568 at text x1.25
situations.why: #553 B2: since Q13 scales Home to 0.85 at 320x568 the long words fit at every phone width at 1x, so the short-caption branch is driven by larger text (gates/drive/textscale.js x1.25: 201.3 px of long words against 162)

breaks.name: caption-always-short
breaks.why: the phone caption is the short one at every width, as before the change: on his phone (and since #553 at 320x568, where Home's 0.85 scale gives the long words room) Discover's caption names no tactics although the long words fit

breaks.name: caption-never-falls-back
breaks.why: the long caption is painted whether or not it fits: where it does not fit (320 wide at text x1.25 since #553; 320 wide at 1x before Q13) it is cut with an ellipsis ('Openings, tactics, endg...'), which is the reason #550 held the item

breaks.name: caption-measured-once
breaks.why: the caption is decided at the first paint and never again: after the window changes width it keeps the words chosen for the old width, cut at the narrow one and short at the wide one

breaks.name: show-button-unnamed
breaks.why: the phone puzzle row's Show button loses its name: a screen reader hears 'Show' here and 'Show move' on every other puzzle screen
